full_judgment: 15. It is in evidence that the plaintiff was all along in Bangladesh and made claim from time to time to the defendants for release of the property starting from 30.6.1972 to 18.7.84 and had filed copies of about 2 dozens letters which are marked exhibits without objection, but no action was taken. Only on 2.1.84 a letter was issued by the Sub-Divisional Officer, Sadar, Dhaka (Exhibit) to appear with his papers in support of his claim. The plaintiff alleged that he produced all his papers but no order was passed. However the claim of the plaintiff was never denied. Hence there is no question of limitation.
